notes: Night Elf: Shadowmeld into Ambush, as the Vanish line.

name: Ambush
when: Stealth is up or Cutthroat is up
notes: Cutthroat procs from Backstab.

name: Preparation
when: Stealth is not up and 3 or fewer combo points and over 60s until Vanish is ready and over 10s of the fight left
notes: Resets Vanish and Cold Blood for a second Ambush.

name: Ghostly Strike
when: Fewer than 5 combo points and (Vanish is not ready or in the last 10s of the fight or 4+ combo points or Slice and Dice is not up)
notes: More damage per Energy than Backstab.

name: Hemorrhage
when: (within 0.25s after a main-hand swing or in the last 6s of the fight) and (Vanish is not ready or in the last 10s of the fight or 4+ combo points or Slice and Dice is not up)

name: Backstab
when: (within 0.25s after a main-hand swing or in the last 6s of the fight) and (Vanish is not ready or in the last 10s of the fight or 4+ combo points or Slice and Dice is not up)

name: Berserking
when: Elemental Mastery is not up and Elemental Mastery is not ready

why: Waits until Elemental Mastery ends. During Mastery, Lightning Bolt already casts as fast as the global cooldown allows, so the haste is wasted.
